html:
Improvements

  • All poems are now written by people in the room—machine-generated lines have been removed.
  • Late joiners see their own waiting character outlined, so it’s clearer who you are before the round starts.
  • The app now runs on a faster hosting setup, making room loading and transitions snappier.
  • Avatars have been refreshed with a new cast of characters.
